profile_text.body:
Credo AI describes itself as an AI governance platform company founded in 2020. According to its website, the company says it created the AI governance category and now focuses on what it calls Agent Governance, offering a registry for every agent plus agentic risk and controls. The platform is built on a Knowledge Graph that the company says fuses global regulatory intelligence with a customer's business context, and it covers agents, applications, models, and vendors from pilot to production. Credo AI says it provides pre-built policy packs with regulatory intelligence for standards and regulations including the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, along with automated workflows and audit-ready evidence. It also offers GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), which it says is generally available in the platform.

The site states that the platform supports model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance in one place, with agents treated as first-class governed entities that are registered, risk-assessed, sanctioned, and governed. Credo AI says its regulatory intelligence is built and updated by agents, validated by human experts, and combined with business context from more than 300 integrations and forward-deployed governance experts. The company says its policy packs were written by a team involved in AI governance standards work at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. Customer statements on the site come from Mastercard and IBM, among others, describing uses such as managing AI risk, implementing generative AI, and accelerating EU AI Act compliance.

The site's own framing is promotional: it calls itself the trusted leader in AI governance and says it built its platform for what it terms Measurable Trust from scratch rather than adding AI features to a GRC tool. It lists Credo AI as its product in the AI governance and risk management platform category, with policy packs for the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF, a clean interface, and fast deployment. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or SEC or patent facts are recorded for the company.
